title: Skyblock Fall Protection
description: Mod to make you warp from the bottom of the world to the top when falling into the void, and prevent you from taking fatal fall damage
body:
Skyblock Fall Protection
=======
This mod both warps you to the top of the world, y = 318 when you fall out of the world, and also prevents you from 
taking fatal fall damage, leaving you on a minimum of half a heart.

You can configure both features either on or off from the Mods -> Configs screen or via the configs folder under `skyblockfallprotection-common.toml`. 

This is useful for skyblock, since constantly having to go get your stuff from the bottom of the world is annoying, or outright impossible if you don't have a graves mod.

This is my first mod, if you run into any bugs or issues, please message me on discord: @ shark_phoenix

For now 26.1 is the only version supported, but minor versions 26.1 and 26.2 shouldn't be hard to make sure works with it.
